definitions.gloss: groundless; completely unfounded; baseless; without any basis
definitions.explanation: Describes a claim, rumor, or story that has no factual basis whatsoever. Literally means having neither roots nor leaves — nothing to support it.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{根|ね}も{葉|は}もない⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧だ。
{根|ね}も{葉|は}もないこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}わないで→言う：00515_iu⟧ほしい。
examples.english: I wish you wouldn't say things that have no basis in fact.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{根|ね}も{葉|は}もない⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}まって→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧、⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{迷惑|めいわく}→迷惑：02432_meiwaku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Baseless information has spread online, and the person involved is very troubled by it.

notes:
Literally means "has neither roots nor leaves" — like a plant with no substance at all. The metaphor conveys that the claim in question has absolutely nothing supporting it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {根|ね}も{葉|は}もない⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧ (groundless rumor)
- {根|ね}も{葉|は}もない⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ (baseless story)
- {根|ね}も{葉|は}もないこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say something groundless)
- {根|ね}も{葉|は}もない⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧ (baseless information)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{根拠|こんきょ}→根拠：10147_konkyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ — without grounds; more formal and analytical
- ⟦{事実無根|じじつむこん}→事実無根：26816_jijitsumukon⟧ — completely untrue, baseless; a formal four-character compound often used in official denials
- ⟦{的外|まとはず}れ→的外れ：16719_matohazure⟧ — off the mark; implies inaccuracy rather than total fabrication

USAGE:
This is a vivid and commonly used expression for dismissing false claims. It is stronger than simply saying ⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧ (a lie) because it emphasizes the complete absence of any factual basis. Often used when someone is frustrated or indignant about a false rumor.
